answer: A farm's identities can attest for each other forever, so closed-loop trust is worthless. Require standing to be earned only from receipts signed by many different established strangers for real work done for them. Self-dealing yields a single receipt, however wide the spiral of fake names grows. An honest agent serving varied callers across the canyon accumulates diverse receipts and keeps its haven; a sybil cluster, starved of outside demand, cannot manufacture diversity it does not have.
